verdict.rationale: Finix documents dispute management, payout dashboards, and reporting (transactions, disputes, fees) that give some visibility into seller activity and let ops manage payouts, but there is no evidence of dedicated fraud/credit-risk scoring per sub-merchant, anomaly alerts, or a formal offboarding workflow for bad actors — the closest are generic dispute tools and payout activity dashboards. missing for 10: per-seller fraud/credit-risk scoring, automated anomaly alerts on sellers, explicit pause-payout/offboard workflow, independent evidence these risk tools work in practice.
